research_question: Which established and emerging culturally associated food expressions and entities occur in permitted Urdu food descriptions?
inclusion_criteria: Food expressions and entities with contextual cultural association, including established names.
Retain original scripts and source contexts; treat transliteration, meaning and cultural association as suggestions until reviewed.
exclusion_criteria: Generic words with no contextual association in the research rubric.
Masked answers absent from the supplied text; invented transliterations and unsupported cultural origins.
